correctness.rationale: Exact lift formula follows by differentiating the 1-periodic real shear through an integral. Fourier approximation proves uniform o(n) Birkhoff sums of its mean-zero derivative for every irrational base angle. Explicit small radius prevents integer winding. Endpoint displacement bounds scale the base difference as O(1/n), and the entire rescaled orbit discrepancy is uniformly close to an affine segment. The Bowen-ball domains converge between uniform parallelogram sandwiches; exact area integration gives 4 epsilon^2/|k|. A covering-by-balls lower bound and O(n) grid upper bound give polynomial entropy 1. All quantifiers (every irrational angle, nonzero integer degree, C1 periodic perturbation, all centers, fixed radius below epsilon0) were checked; no finite experiment is used.

value.rationale: Beyond the already known linear polynomial-entropy scale, the theorem determines the exact fixed-resolution normalized Haar mass and limiting geometric parallelogram of n-step orbit indistinguishability. The coefficient is robust to arbitrary C1 periodic perturbations and insensitive to Diophantine rates, revealing how integer winding governs observable local orbit complexity. The exact metric-dependent fact is a natural quantitative refinement of polynomial entropy and gives a sharp sampling/covering lower prefactor for this family; it is not a renaming, tiny bound increment, or mere entropy re-proof.
